type: Complete source-chapter first pass and scoped dependency/overlap triage
read_method: All saved source lines directly read in contiguous chunks, including statements, complete displayed proofs, comments, formulas, figures and adjoining prose. This is a first complete source pass, not a second book-proof review or a closed inclusion audit.

confirmed_new_obligations.missing_scope: A global quasi-psh pole for a locally pluripolar set on an arbitrary compact complex manifold, delegated to Vu19. Existing Q03 proves the Euclidean Josefson theorem; this is a distinct global statement.

Coherence of the bounded-growth ideal of analytic singularities. The source identifies it as a proper direct image but gives no direct-image-coherence proof. The previous Q12 obligation was excluded with later theories; this Part I foundation remains required.

Extension of a strictly positive submanifold quasi-psh potential with Holder-continuous exponential to a strictly positive ambient potential, preserving analytic singularities when present. Delegated to DRWNXZ Theorem 6.1. Existing OT section extensions do not prove this potential-extension result.

confirmed_proof_findings.finding: The bounded-above branch has an explicit logarithmic-pole construction. The codimension-two branch uses a direction projection of a compact portion of an analytic set and invokes Remmert without an analytic source neighborhood on which that projection is proper. A compact portion alone is not such a source.
confirmed_proof_findings.scope: Q02 uses Hausdorff-null directional slicing; A01 supplies analytic-strata dimension bounds. Retain these prerequisites, rather than importing the source projection argument.

confirmed_proof_findings.finding: Supremum slopes alone do not prove addition: sup(u+v) need not equal sup(u)+sup(v).
confirmed_proof_findings.scope: The saved Q05 spherical-mean identity and linearity proof directly read. Its earlier chapter review/dependency gate remains distinct from this source finding.

confirmed_proof_findings.finding: The analytic finite-resolution statement must include strict transforms, not only exceptional divisors. For c log|z1|^2, the identity resolution has no exceptional divisors, but its multiplier ideal is nontrivial when c>=1.
confirmed_proof_findings.scope: Complete saved Q05 finite-resolution proof and example directly read; complete general uniform-parameter proof also checked at its needed source scope.

confirmed_proof_findings.finding: The unqualified assertion that every locally rational analytic singularity has one global rational-coefficient ideal type needs a scope restriction. On an infinite disjoint union of discs, coefficients 1/j at their origins have no common positive rational unit.
confirmed_proof_findings.scope: Audit the book global-type construction in its exact compact setting; no general noncompact global-type claim is closed here.
